Package org.saidone.protoalf.client

package org.saidone.protoalf.client
Java clients for the repository services exposed by the protoalf platform module.

Each service has a matching client and operation names: nodes, file/folder operations, content, versions, search, dictionary models and authentication. Clients exchange Protobuf data objects and require no Spring or MCP runtime. The application owns its channel and can share one AuthenticationServiceClient as the TicketProvider for all service clients.

Unary calls attach a ticket and deadline, renewing an expired ticket and retrying once when a different ticket becomes available. Downloads retry only before any payload bytes are written; uploads never replay their input. Callers retain ownership of supplied input/output streams.

  • Class
    Description
    AlfrescoGrpcChannels
    Creates channels to the protoalf-platform module.
    AuthenticationServiceClient
    Client of the AuthenticationService of the gRPC module: exchanges user and password for an Alfresco ticket, gRPC only, no REST.
    ContentServiceClient
    Client of the platform's content service: byte slices, writes, downloads and streaming document creation.
    DictionaryServiceClient
    Client of the platform's dictionary service for model listings and qualified model lookups.
    FileFolderServiceClient
    Client of the platform's file/folder service: listing, creation, moves and copies.
    NodeArchiveServiceClient
    Client of the platform's node archive service: lists and permanently purges the nodes in the trashcan.
    NodeServiceClient
    Client of the platform's node service for properties, types, aspects and node snapshots.
    Properties
    Typed property factories shared by all write clients.
    SearchServiceClient
    Client of the platform's search service, supporting AFTS, CMIS, pagination and ordered AFTS sort fields.
    TicketProvider
    Supplies the Alfresco authentication ticket sent to the gRPC module in the alfresco-ticket header: every call runs as the user the ticket belongs to.
    VersionServiceClient
    Client of the platform's version service.
